headline: Sammaan Capital Limited: Regulation 57 Compliance Certification-Timely Debenture Interest Payment
sum: Sammaan Capital Limited has filed a Regulation 57 certification with NSE confirming timely payment of interest on its listed Secured and Unsecured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures. The filing fulfils the company's mandatory disclosure obligation under SEBI LODR 2015.
implication: Routine debenture-servicing disclosure reinforces listed issuer's credit discipline and bondholder confidence; non-compliance with Reg 57 triggers exchange censure and reputational damage, making this filing a lightweight but material governance marker.
detail: Sammaan Capital Limited, an Indian financial services company with debentures listed on NSE/BSE, has submitted a formal certification under Regulation 57 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, confirming that interest payments on both its Secured and Unsecured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures issued via public issue have been made on time. This filing is a mandatory periodic disclosure required of all listed debt issuers to ensure market transparency and bondholder confidence.
